records.part: Silane Distribution System (gas rack and VMB) for Boulder Micro-Fabrication Facility
records.reason: the Government intends to issue a Sole Source Award to CVD Equipment Corporation, 355, South Technology Drive, Central Islip, NY 11722, US, under the authority of FAR 12.102(a).
records.installed_location: Boulder Micro-Fabrication Facility (BMF), Katharine Blodgett Gebbie Building, Boulder, CO

records.part: Existing installed base of toxic gas cabinets integrated into TGMS
records.reason: The BMF currently has an installed base of six SDC Ciphercon 1500 toxic gas cabinets, which are fully integrated into our facility's TGMS.

records.part: Silane gas rack (two-cylinder system with silane and nitrogen purge) compatible with existing CiphercoN infrastructure
records.reason: The new gas rack shall be a CiphercoN\u2122 1500 Gas Rack or equivalent with the following specifications: Be able to be repaired using spare parts from the Government\u2019s existing stock of spare parts for a SDC CiphercoNTM 1500 cabinet.

records.part: Valve Manifold Box (VMB) to distribute UHP silane to up to 8 process tools
records.reason: The new gas rack shall be a FlexGas\u2122 VMB or equivalent with the following specifications: Be able to receive gas from the gas rack and deliver UHP silane to up to 8 process tools in a manner that is consistent with semiconductor industry standards.
